messages:
Sam H: FYI customer Vireo Labs says procurement won't accept invoices without an official PO + SOW reference. They just emailed their checklist, looks strict.

Lina M: Can they accept a pro-forma while PO is processed? We've used that as a stop-gap for some enterprise deals.

Sam H: Procurement explicitly wrote 'no invoices until PO received' — they also require the SOW ID on the billing doc. Pasted their email below.

Sam H: ```Email snippet:
To bill Vireo Labs, include: PO number, SOW ID, Billing contact, W9, VAT registration (if EU).
Procurement contact: marta@vireolabs.com
Note: invoices submitted without PO will be rejected by AP.```

Jordan C: Could we issue a labeled pro-forma (non-payable) with the SOW and note 'pending PO' so sales/onboarding can proceed? That usually keeps customers moving.

Priya B: FYI our billing policy forbids issuing an official taxable invoice when customer mandates a PO. We can create a pro-forma that is clearly non-invoice. Legal needs to OK wording, and we must not mark it as revenue.

Lina M: @Legal can you confirm pro-forma language is sufficient and that it won't trip internal revenue recognition rules? Also confirm W9 requirement — Vireo is US-based.

AccountsBot: Pro-forma draft PF-2026-091 created by Priya B. Expires in 30 days. Link: https://redwood.example.com/billing/proforma/PF-2026-091

Sam H: I'll reply to Marta with the pro-forma and request an expedited PO number + SOW reference. Will also ask for any additional procurement codes they need on the invoice.

Jordan C: If PO is delayed beyond ~14 days, recommend offering a one-time onboarding credit so the integration isn't blocked. That avoids a churn risk. @Finance please advise.

Priya B: Finance is OK with a 2-week trial credit as long as Sales documents the credit and we attach a ticket to the account. Need AC (account owner) sign-off.

Lina M: I can provide AC sign-off. I'll DM Sam the exact credit wording and loop in Sales Ops to record it.

Sam H: Thanks — I'll update Vireo and attach PF-2026-091. Will post back when PO arrives or if procurement asks for more docs. :thumbsup:

Jordan C: Great, appreciate the quick turnaround. If they ask for tax-related docs (VAT/W9) we should attach our standard packet to avoid back-and-forth.

Priya B: I'll upload the standard W9 + tax packet to the pro-forma link.

Sam H: Closing loop for now — follow-ups will be added to this thread.
